from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialLineItem(BaseModel):
    """A single financial item extracted from one company's report."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="Company name in this report")
    stock_code: str | None = Field(description="Stock/securities code")
    period: str | None = Field(description="Report period, e.g. '2024年第一季度'")
    item_name: str | None = Field(description="Financial line item name")
    begin_balance: float | None = Field(description="Beginning of period balance in yuan")
    end_balance: float | None = Field(description="Ending balance in yuan")
    change_percentage: str | None = Field(description="Change percentage if stated")
    change_reason: str | None = Field(description="Reason for change, if stated")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_items: list[FinancialLineItem]
